title: Autostart applications on Xorg startup
summary: To run scripts or applications when Xorg starts, add them to your xinitrc or xprofile file. Use xinitrc if you start X manually with xinit, or xprofile if you use a display manager.

steps.explain: If you start Xorg manually using xinit, add your startup commands to ~/.xinitrc. If you use a display manager (like GDM or SDDM), add them to ~/.xprofile instead.
steps.gui: Open ~/.xinitrc or ~/.xprofile in a text editor and add the command to launch your application at the end of the file.

rollback.explain: Remove the added lines from ~/.xinitrc or ~/.xprofile.
rollback.gui: Open the file in a text editor and delete the lines you added.

warnings: Editing these files incorrectly can prevent your graphical session from starting. Keep a backup.
